from tinydb import TinyDB, Query, where
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage

db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db.insert({'name': 'ana', 'home': {'city': 'Pune'}, 'work': {'city': 'Delhi'}})
db.insert({'name': 'raj', 'home': {'city': 'Delhi'}, 'work': {'city': 'Pune'}})
User = Query()

r1 = db.search(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))
r2 = db.search(User.work.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))
print('home', [d['name'] for d in r1])
print('work', [d['name'] for d in r2])
assert [d['name'] for d in r1] == ['ana']
assert [d['name'] for d in r2] == ['raj']

# equality / hash
assert User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) != User.work.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
assert User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) == User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
assert hash(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})) == hash(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))

# root-level fragment vs nested fragment with same doc
db2 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db2.insert({'city': 'Pune', 'home': {'city': 'X'}})
db2.insert({'city': 'X', 'home': {'city': 'Pune'}})
a = db2.search(Query().fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))
b = db2.search(Query().home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))
print('root', a, 'nested', b)
assert a == [{'city': 'Pune', 'home': {'city': 'X'}}]
assert b == [{'city': 'X', 'home': {'city': 'Pune'}}]
assert Query().fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) != Query().home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})

# deeper paths, where(), count, missing field
assert db.count(where('home').fragment({'city': 'Delhi'})) == 1
assert db.search(User.nope.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})) == []
assert db.search(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) & User.work.fragment({'city': 'Delhi'}))[0]['name'] == 'ana'

# cache still used for repeated identical queries
q = User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
db.search(q)
assert q in db.table('_default')._query_cache
print('OK')

from tinydb import TinyDB, Query, where
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage


def _db():
    db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
    db.insert({'name': 'ana', 'home': {'city': 'Pune'}, 'work': {'city': 'Delhi'}})
    db.insert({'name': 'raj', 'home': {'city': 'Delhi'}, 'work': {'city': 'Pune'}})
    return db


def test_issue_repro():
    db = _db()
    User = Query()
    r1 = db.search(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))
    r2 = db.search(User.work.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))
    assert [d['name'] for d in r1] == ['ana']
    assert [d['name'] for d in r2] == ['raj']


def test_equality_and_hash():
    User = Query()
    assert User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) != User.work.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
    assert User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) == User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
    assert hash(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})) == hash(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))
    assert Query().fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) != Query().home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})


def test_root_vs_nested_same_db():
    db2 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
    db2.insert({'city': 'Pune', 'home': {'city': 'X'}})
    db2.insert({'city': 'X', 'home': {'city': 'Pune'}})
    a = db2.search(Query().fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))
    b = db2.search(Query().home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))
    assert a == [{'city': 'Pune', 'home': {'city': 'X'}}]
    assert b == [{'city': 'X', 'home': {'city': 'Pune'}}]


def test_misc_edges():
    db = _db()
    User = Query()
    assert db.count(where('home').fragment({'city': 'Delhi'})) == 1
    assert db.search(User.nope.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})) == []
    res = db.search(User.home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}) & User.work.fragment({'city': 'Delhi'}))
    assert [d['name'] for d in res] == ['ana']
    # deeper path
    db.insert({'name': 'z', 'a': {'b': {'city': 'Pune'}}})
    assert [d['name'] for d in db.search(User.a.b.fragment({'city': 'Pune'}))] == ['z']
    assert db.search(User.a.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})) == []


def test_cache_still_used():
    db = _db()
    q = Query().home.fragment({'city': 'Pune'})
    db.search(q)
    assert q in db.table('_default')._query_cache

input.summary: I approve the PR. It fixes the bug with a one-line change at tinydb/queries.py:499: the fragment query's hash now includes the field path, as ARCHITECTURE.md C2 requires. Before, fragment queries on different fields hashed and compared as equal, so the table's query cache returned the first field's results for the second search. The full suite passes (232 tests). My own 5-test probe also passes: it covers the issue's example, equality and hashing, root-level versus nested fragments, edge cases, and confirms the cache is still used. My first attempt to run the probe as a plain script failed because tinydb wasn't importable from the scratch directory, so I reran it as a pytest file. Remaining findings: one minor (the new tests don't check the equality/hash symptom the issue reports) and one nit (an unused import and a test file named after the workflow).
